selection_rule: NOT A SELECTION. This is the sensitivity arm declared in D-28 and docs/preregistration_model_sensitivity.md. D-01 stands and configs/model_selection.json remains the primary arm from which every headline number is taken. This config exists so the same sweep can be run a second time with only the generator weights changed, to test whether a UER rise with hop is an artefact of the primary model's citation failure (17/20 wrong passage IDs, 10/20 nonverbatim quotes in the C2 pilot). Reading the arms is governed by the table pre-registered before any run.
scope: one pinned model for all conditions within a sweep; this arm is reported beside the primary arm and never in place of it
